# AVCONEXPO - Industrial Engineering, EPC & Supply Chain Company

Website: https://www.avconexpo.com/
Head Office: Lucknow, India
Global Focus: Africa, Middle East (Gulf), India

---

## Company Overview

AVCONEXPO is an Engineering, EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction), Architecture, Supply Chain, and Industrial Consultancy company.

We provide end-to-end industrial solutions from concept to commissioning including:
- Greenfield & Brownfield Projects
- Industrial Plant Setup
- EPC Turnkey Execution
- Technical & Business Consultancy
- Industrial Revival & Optimization
- Supply Chain Management
- Waste Management & Energy Recovery
- Agro Processing & Value Chain Development
- Startup Acceleration & Industrial Strategy

---
